messages.author: 156474edcb8cde2c
messages.subject: Issues with shiny app under safari
parts:
Hi all,

I am been developing shiny apps to generate diagrams with DiagrammeR locally without any issue. But when uploaded the app on shinyapp.io started experiencing serious issues with the rendering of the diagram color. With safari (the diagram shows black) 















With chrome (the correct color gradient can be seen)

I generated a simple reproducible example (code attached). I cannot see any error or warning from the shinyapp.io log (see below). The app can be tested at: https://guiastrennec.shinyapps.io/diagrammer_bug/. Any suggestions on the cause of this issue are welcome.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Issues with shiny app under safari
parts:
Hi Ben,
Unfortunately the issue is one that needs to be resolved by the creator of htmlwidget.  We haven't quite found a way around it, but here is the link that describes the issue and the pull request that was needed to make it work for flexdashboard, and I am guessing the same issue is there for diagrammeR. 

https://github.com/rstudio/flexdashboard/issues/94 

We will see if there is a way for us to fix this at a deeper level in the htmlwdigets itself, but for now I think this is unfortunately the best course of action.

-Tareef

Kind regards,
